title: Clarify Clippy follow-up messaging when its advisory report is incomplete
outcome: Clippy reporting distinguishes completed lint-only follow-up from a failed tool or incomplete report, while retaining Greg's non-blocking Clippy decision and the standing compile, test and review requirements.
acceptance: Observable report/summary tests distinguish a completed lint report from a failed or incomplete report: failed reports retain their failure and native cause, and the lint-only next-round line is limited to completed reports.

Docs and summary wording preserve the recorded rule: Clippy findings alone do not fail the gate or block landing; compile errors, test failures and Medium-or-higher review findings retain the standing rule. No test pins repository Markdown or instruction text.
